objective.why: Make Brallin's pings lethal and both commanders bigger faster: wheels that also remove (Collective Defiance, Fateful Showdown, Incendiary Command), multipliers (Lae'zel, Torbran, Alhammarret's Archive), recovery (Boros Charm, Campfire, Command Beacon), Big Score, four red-leaning lands. Champion kill_by_6 0.206 (±0.016) on the 2026-10-11 model; the 17-swap screen read 0.261 (pilot, 2026-10-17).

commits.message:
torbran-v1: the DeckCheck sweep staged — free interaction, a bracket-3 floor, three cheap lands

In: March of Swirling Mist, Silence, Snapback, Spider-Man New Champion, Fevered Visions;
Riverglide Pathway, Mountain, Temple of Epiphany. Out: Teferi's Protection (the fourth
Game Changer), Shelter, Improbable Alliance, Containment Construct, Marauding Mako;
Calciform Pools, Reliquary Tower, Nimbus Maze. Queen Kayla and Ivora stay: the roast
called them out, the bench reads each as a repeatable wheel payoff. Four of the five
spell adds are invisible to the goldfish and were staged on the argument, not the figure.
